newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Arab bourses officials to discuss joint exchange.
newsitem.headline: Arab bourses officials to discuss joint exchange.

text.p: Arab bourse officials will discuss creating a joint Arab bourse in a meeting to be held in Cairo on May 15, an official of the Union of Arab Stock Exchanges and Securities Commissions said on Sunday.

"The studies and research that would be discussed during the conference include...creating a joint Arab stock exchange," the official Kuwait News Agency quoted the Union's General Secretary Sa'faq al-Rukeibi as saying.
The Union, in its May 15-17 annual meeting, will also tackle the possibility of establishing common Arab clearing and brokerage companies, he said, without giving further details.
